digest.component_or_area: live-DC readiness harness and probe workflows
propositions: The live-DC readiness gate polls /rest/api/2/serverInfo until 200 but does not verify that required Epic Link and Epic Name fields are registered, allowing a timing flake where the gate succeeds before the plugin's custom fields are available

A system-only field inventory (27 system fields, zero customfield_* entries) was observed one second after serverInfo went green, proving the plugin initializes its fields asynchronously after the instance becomes health-check ready
The harness survives this latent flake only because it runs slow downstream work before calling _assert_project_capabilities, while the probe exposes the bug immediately and sees the missing fields
Gerrit 1387 fixed only the probe script without adding tests and without fixing the harness path, creating divergence between two readiness definitions instead of establishing one shared definition

The readiness gate must poll /rest/api/2/field until every name in REQUIRED_FIELDS is present under a bounded budget and fail with the observed inventory dump on expiry, distinguishing 'not registered yet' from 'image does not offer' rather than misattributing to image degrade

GreenHopper's Epic Link and Epic Name fields are provisioned when the first Jira Software project is created, not when the plugin starts, so a field-wait at session fixture setup deadlocks and must be moved to after project creation
